title: invalid AuthProvider header value: silently ignored on HTTP paths, panics on WS path
description: On HTTP paths (fetch_session, call, blob), reqwest returns Err from .send() when a header value is invalid — this maps to ClientError::Http. On the WS path (connect_ws), http::HeaderValue::from_str() is called explicitly and returns ClientError::InvalidArgument. So the same invalid AuthProvider implementation produces two different error types for the same root cause (bad header value): ClientError::Http on HTTP code paths, ClientError::InvalidArgument on WS. Callers matching on error variants will need different code paths for the same root cause. This is a secondary concern vs JMAP-3m6.8 (which is the actionable doc fix); but the type asymmetry is still real.
